carrier: The Halden Indemnity Company, Hartford — est. 1908

namedInsured.name: Hollis & Verne Electrical
namedInsured.trade: Electrical contractor — licensed, residential and light commercial

coverage: Sums the insured becomes legally obligated to pay as damages because of property damage caused by an occurrence, including property damage arising out of the insured's completed operations. Halden has the right and duty to defend.
carrierHistory: Halden Indemnity succeeded Cornerline Commercial Casualty as the insured's CGL carrier effective 2025-11-01. Certificates of insurance issued for earlier renovation files may still name Cornerline; the policy in force at the date of the work (2026-03-14) and the date of the occurrence (2026-07-19) is this policy.

conditions.noticeOfDemand: The insured or Halden's Inward Claims desk records any demand or suit on the day of receipt; receipt is acknowledged in writing.
conditions.noVoluntaryAdmission: No insured will, except at that insured's own cost, voluntarily make a payment, assume any obligation, or admit any liability without Halden's written consent. Admission of liability on Halden's side is reserved to supervising counsel; no claims desk, human or automated, holds that authority.
conditions.positionCommitment: Halden states its position on a demand in writing by a committed date, and keeps the date.
conditions.recordsExamination: Halden evaluates a demand on records it has examined itself. A record offered as evidence is verified before it is relied on; a record that cannot be verified is not evidence.

inwardClaims.authority: The desk may acknowledge receipt, verify offered evidence, evaluate the demand against this policy, and issue Halden's position — acceptance of payment, dispute, or a request for further evidence. The desk may never admit liability (see noVoluntaryAdmission).
